component.name: Teams + Outlook Workspace
component.summary: Use Teams and Outlook in one window with header tabs

description.p: An independent fork of Teams for Linux by Ismael Martinez and contributors, maintained by Marwan Nofal. Teams and Outlook stay open in one window with a navigation bar at the top.
This unofficial client uses Microsoft's web applications. A Microsoft account and internet connection are required. This project is not affiliated with Microsoft.
